stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class, ADM2023): 6,159 applied, 4,220 admitted, 1,162 enrolled. Winona State's newest posted Common Data Set is 2022-2023 (numbers not machine-readable), so no CDS is used; GPA distribution, residency and international applicant/admit counts are not available. College Navigator shows 6,642 applicants and 75% admitted for Fall 2024 (exact admits not given, so none are stored). Undergraduate enrollment (5,317) is the College Navigator Fall 2024 figure; international undergraduate count left null.

cds_test_policy.notes: Winona State does not require ACT or SAT for admission; scores are encouraged for placement and some scholarships.

cost.notes: International page (heading says 2025-2026; health insurance dates are Aug 2026-Aug 2027): tuition $8,934 for 24-36 credits after the automatic Cross-Cultural Scholarship, student fees $1,304, international programs fee $150, double room with 14-meal plan $10,240, mandatory eWarrior laptop program $970, health insurance $2,956. The page's printed total ($24,097) does not match its own lines, so no total is stored. Books and personal expenses are not included.
